rotate_bounding_box: rotate a bounding box by a given angle (0, 90, 180, or 270 degrees) and return a BoundingRectangle
test_rotate_bounding_box_0: test rotate_bounding_box with a 0-degree angle returns the original bounding rectangle
test_rotate_bounding_box_90: test rotate_bounding_box with a 90-degree angle returns the rotated bounding rectangle
test_rotate_bounding_box_180: test rotate_bounding_box with a 180-degree angle returns the rotated bounding rectangle
test_rotate_bounding_box_270: test rotate_bounding_box with a 270-degree angle returns the rotated bounding rectangle
